unitTitle: Subject/Object Personal Pronouns - The verb 'to be' - Have got - Can - Present Simple - Present Continuous

pairsWith.noteUz: Bu mashq beti Grammar 4-6-betlardagi nazariyaga (olmoshlar, to be, have got, can, Present Simple) tegishli.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 1-UNIT MAShQLAR, 1-BET (7-bet, PDF 6). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '1'. Ikki ustun, to'q sariq bo'lim sarlavhalari.

CHAP USTUN:
'Personal Pronouns':
1) 'Replace the underlined words with the correct subject or object personal pronouns, as in the example.' 1 Rachel likes Sarah. → She likes her. 2 "Is Robert your brother?" 3 "Do you like the Spice Girls?" 4 The cake is delicious. 5 My mother makes biscuits for my brother and me. 6 "Do Tom and Charles live in Brighton?" 7 Joanne and Mary go to the beach every day. 8 Susan is 16 years old. 9 Tim doesn't know Roberta. 10 My father and I like basketball. (Tagiga chizilgan so'zlar: Rachel, Sarah; Robert; the Spice Girls; The cake; my brother and me; Tom and Charles; Joanne and Mary; Susan; Tim, Roberta; My father and I.)
'The verb "to be"':
2) 'Fill in the gaps with am/'m/'m not, is/'s/isn't, are/'re/aren't.' 1 ...... she a singer? Yes, she ...... . She ...... a singer. 2 ...... your dog dangerous? No, he ...... . He ...... gentle. 3 ...... you from Sweden? Yes, we ...... . We ...... from Sweden. 4 ...... his father a painter? No, he ...... . He ...... an actor. 5 ...... you a vet? Yes, I ...... . 6 ...... he your brother? No, he ...... . He ...... my cousin. 7 ...... you a teacher? No, I ...... . I ...... a policewoman. 8 ...... they sad? No, they ...... . They ...... happy.
'The verb "have got"':
3) 'Write questions and answers, as in the example.' 1 Emily ✗ car ✓ bicycle. A: Has Emily got a car? B: No, Emily hasn't got a car. She has got a bicycle. 2 Carl ✗ beard ✓ moustache. 3 Samantha ✗ blue eyes ✓ brown eyes. 4 Jane and Tim ✗ stereo ✓ TV. 5 Joe ✗ wrinkles ✓ freckles. 6 You ✗ long hair ✓ short hair. 7 Lucy ✗ typewriter ✓ computer.

O'NG USTUN:
'The verb "can"':
4) 'Make true sentences using can or can't, as in the example.' 1 an elephant / play tennis → An elephant can't play tennis. 2 a typist / type letters 3 a whale / read 4 an artist / paint pictures 5 a sheep / fly 6 a chef / cook delicious dishes
5) 'Write three true sentences about yourself, as in the example.' I can swim but I can't fly a plane.
'Present Simple':
6) 'Put the verbs below in the correct box in the third person singular.' dive, teach, try, drink, type, fix, fly, write, stay, miss, fry, say, crash, cry. Uch ustun: -s, -es, -ies.
7) 'Use the prompts to make sentences, as in the example.' 1 Mary / live / in / town / near Dublin. → Mary lives in a town near Dublin. 2 John / not have got / brown eyes. (davomi keyingi betda)

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '7'.

exercises.instructionEn: Replace the underlined words with the correct subject or object personal pronouns, as in the example. Example: Rachel likes Sarah. → She likes her.
exercises.instructionUz: Tagiga chizilgan so'zlarni to'g'ri ega yoki tushum olmoshi bilan almashtiring, namunadagidek. Namuna: Rachel likes Sarah. → She likes her.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLMOSh BILAN ALMAShTIRISh.

  EGA (fe'ldan oldin) → I, you,
    he, she, it, we, they
  TUShUM (fe'l/predlogdan keyin) →
    me, you, him, her, it, us, them

  1 Rachel → She; Sarah → her
  2 Robert → he (ega)
  3 the Spice Girls → them (tushum)
  4 The cake → It
  5 my brother and me → us
  6 Tom and Charles → they
  7 Joanne and Mary → They
  8 Susan → She
  9 Tim → He; Roberta → her
  10 My father and I → We


⚠ 'THE SPICE GIRLS':

  Guruh (ko'plik) → them.

items.textEn: "Do you like the Spice Girls?" → "Do you like ___?"
The cake is delicious. → ___ is delicious.
My mother makes biscuits for my brother and me. → My mother makes biscuits for ___.
"Do Tom and Charles live in Brighton?" → "Do ___ live in Brighton?"
Joanne and Mary go to the beach every day. → ___ go to the beach every day.
Susan is 16 years old. → ___ is 16 years old.
Tim doesn't know Roberta. → ___ doesn't know ___.
My father and I like basketball. → ___ like basketball.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with am/'m/'m not, is/'s/isn't, are/'re/aren't.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni am/'m/'m not, is/'s/isn't, are/'re/aren't bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
'TO BE' - SAVOL, QISQA JAVOB,
  TASDIQ/INKOR.

  Savol: Is / Are + ega ...?
  Qisqa javob: Yes, she IS. / No,
    he ISN'T.
  Keyingi gap: She'S a singer. /
    He'S gentle.

  ⚠ 'Are you a vet?' → 'Yes, I
  AM.' (you → I)
  ⚠ 'Are you from Sweden?' → 'Yes,
  WE are.' (ko'plik javob)


⚠ 'GENTLE':

  = yuvosh, muloyim.


⚠ 'A VET':

  = veterinar.

items.textEn: ___ she a singer? Yes, she ___. She ___ a singer.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Is she ...? Yes, she is. She's a singer.

items.textEn: ___ your dog dangerous? No, he ___. He ___ gentle.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Is your dog ...? No, he isn't. He's gentle.

items.textEn: ___ you from Sweden? Yes, we ___. We ___ from Sweden.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Are you ...? Yes, we are. We're from Sweden.

items.textEn: ___ his father a painter? No, he ___. He ___ an actor.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Is his father ...? No, he isn't. He's an actor.
⚠ Are you a vet? Yes, I am.

items.textEn: ___ he your brother? No, he ___. He ___ my cousin.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Is he ...? No, he isn't. He's my cousin.

items.textEn: ___ you a teacher? No, I ___. I ___ a policewoman.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Are you ...? No, I'm not. I'm a policewoman.

items.textEn: ___ they sad? No, they ___. They ___ happy.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Are they sad? No, they aren't. They're happy.

exercises.instructionEn: Write questions and answers, as in the example. 1 Emily ✗ car ✓ bicycle. 2 Carl ✗ beard ✓ moustache. 3 Samantha ✗ blue eyes ✓ brown eyes. 4 Jane and Tim ✗ stereo ✓ TV. 5 Joe ✗ wrinkles ✓ freckles. 6 You ✗ long hair ✓ short hair. 7 Lucy ✗ typewriter ✓ computer.
exercises.instructionUz: Namunadagidek savol va javob yozing. 1 Emili ✗ mashina ✓ velosiped. 2 Karl ✗ soqol ✓ mo'ylov. 3 Samanta ✗ ko'k ko'zlar ✓ jigarrang ko'zlar. 4 Jeyn va Tim ✗ stereo ✓ televizor. 5 Jo ✗ ajinlar ✓ sepkillar. 6 Siz ✗ uzun soch ✓ kalta soch. 7 Lyusi ✗ yozuv mashinkasi ✓ kompyuter.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAVE GOT - SAVOL, INKOR, TASDIQ.

  A: Has/Have + kim + got + ✗?
  B: No, ... hasn't/haven't got ✗.
     ... has/have got ✓.

  ⚠ Jane and Tim → HAVE (ko'plik)
  ⚠ You → 'Have you got ...?' →
    'No, I haven't got ...' (javob
    'I' bilan)


⚠ 'WRINKLES' va 'FRECKLES':

  wrinkles = ajinlar; freckles =
  sepkillar.


⚠ 'A TYPEWRITER':

  = yozuv mashinkasi.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 A: Has Emily got a car? B: No, Emily hasn't got a car. She has got a bicycle.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 A: Emilining mashinasi bormi? B: Yo'q, Emilining mashinasi yo'q. Uning velosipedi bor.
modelAnswers: 1 A: Has Emily got a car? B: No, Emily hasn't got a car. She has got a bicycle.
2 A: Has Carl got a beard? B: No, Carl hasn't got a beard. He has got a moustache.
3 A: Has Samantha got blue eyes? B: No, Samantha hasn't got blue eyes. She has got brown eyes.
4 A: Have Jane and Tim got a stereo? B: No, Jane and Tim haven't got a stereo. They have got a TV.
5 A: Has Joe got wrinkles? B: No, Joe hasn't got wrinkles. He has got freckles.
6 A: Have you got long hair? B: No, I haven't got long hair. I have got short hair.
7 A: Has Lucy got a typewriter? B: No, Lucy hasn't got a typewriter. She has got a computer.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Emilining mashinasi bormi? - Yo'q, mashinasi yo'q. Velosipedi bor. (NAMUNA)
2 Karlning soqoli bormi? - Yo'q, soqoli yo'q. Mo'ylovi bor.
3 Samantaning ko'zlari ko'kmi? - Yo'q, ko'k emas. Ko'zlari jigarrang.
4 Jeyn va Timning stereosi bormi? - Yo'q, stereosi yo'q. Televizori bor. (have - ko'plik)
5 Joning ajinlari bormi? - Yo'q, ajinlari yo'q. Sepkillari bor.
6 Sochingiz uzunmi? - Yo'q, uzun emas. Sochim kalta. (you → I)
7 Lyusining yozuv mashinkasi bormi? - Yo'q, yo'q. Kompyuteri bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Make true sentences using can or can't, as in the example. 1 an elephant / play tennis 2 a typist / type letters 3 a whale / read 4 an artist / paint pictures 5 a sheep / fly 6 a chef / cook delicious dishes
exercises.instructionUz: Can yoki can't ishlatib to'g'ri (haqiqiy) gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 fil / tennis o'ynash 2 mashinistka / xat yozish 3 kit / o'qish 4 rassom / rasm chizish 5 qo'y / uchish 6 oshpaz / mazali taomlar pishirish
exercises.explanationUz:
CAN / CAN'T - HAQIQAT.

  Hayvonlar - CAN'T (tennis, o'qish,
  uchish)
  Kasb egalari - CAN (o'z ishini
  qila oladi)

  1 elephant - can't play tennis
  2 typist - CAN type letters
  3 whale - can't read
  4 artist - CAN paint pictures
  5 sheep - can't fly
  6 chef - CAN cook delicious
    dishes


⚠ 'A TYPIST':

  = mashinistka (yozuvchi).


⚠ 'A CHEF':

  = oshpaz (bosh).
modelAnswers: 6 A chef can cook delicious dishes.

exercises.instructionEn: Write three true sentences about yourself, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: O'zingiz haqingizda uchta to'g'ri gap yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'ZIM HAQIMDA - CAN ... BUT
  CAN'T ...

  I can + qila oladigan ish
  but I can't + qila olmaydigan
  ish.

  ⚠ 'but' = lekin - qarama-qarshi
  ikki qismni bog'laydi.
exercises.exampleEn: I can swim but I can't fly a plane.
exercises.exampleUz: Men suza olaman, lekin samolyot uchira olmayman.
modelAnswers: I can swim but I can't fly a plane.
I can speak Uzbek but I can't speak Chinese.
I can ride a bike but I can't drive a car.
I can cook rice but I can't make a cake.
modelAnswersUz: Men suza olaman, lekin samolyot uchira olmayman. (NAMUNA)
Men o'zbekcha gapira olaman, lekin xitoycha gapira olmayman.
Men velosiped hayday olaman, lekin mashina hayday olmayman.
Men guruch pishira olaman, lekin tort qila olmayman.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs below in the correct box in the third person singular: dive, teach, try, drink, type, fix, fly, write, stay, miss, fry, say, crash, cry. Boxes: -s, -es, -ies.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi fe'llarni 3-shaxs birlikda to'g'ri ustunga joylashtiring: dive, teach, try, drink, type, fix, fly, write, stay, miss, fry, say, crash, cry. Ustunlar: -s, -es, -ies.
exercises.explanationUz:
IMLO QOIDASI (6-bet).

  -S (oddiy): dives, drinks, types,
    writes, stays, says
    ⚠ stay, say - UNLI + y → -s

  -ES (-ch, -x, -ss, -sh): teaches,
    fixes, misses, crashes

  -IES (UNDOSh + y): tries, flies,
    fries, cries

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to make sentences, as in the example. 1 Mary / live / in / town / near Dublin. 2 John / not have got / brown eyes. (continued on page 8)
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 Mary / live / in / town / near Dublin. 2 John / not have got / brown eyes. (davomi 8-betda)
exercises.explanationUz:
GAP TUZISh - PRESENT SIMPLE.

  1 Mary LIVES in A town near
    Dublin. (-s va artikl 'a'
    qo'shildi)
  2 John HASN'T GOT brown eyes.
    (not have got → hasn't got)

  ⚠ Mashqning 3-8-bandlari 8-betda
  davom etadi.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 Mary lives in a town near Dublin.
modelAnswers: 1 Mary lives in a town near Dublin.

patterns.formula: Has + KIM + got + NIMA? — No, ... hasn't got ... . ... has got ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Has Emily got a car? — No, Emily hasn't got a car. She has got a bicycle.

patterns.exampleEn: A typist can type letters. A sheep can't fly.
patterns.exampleUz: Mashinistka xat yoza oladi. Qo'y ucha olmaydi.
